name: hound-wasp-squeeze
description: Combination stage of the houndframe trial (?hound=2). Same route and same terrain jump as hound-grounded.json, with the dodge jump at 1200ms — a timing that is completely safe against the lone houndframe (the measured solo-safe window is 1200-1330ms) and costs a hit every run once a wasp cruises the arc over the hound's plate, because clearing the charge early enough now lands inside the dive. That narrowing is the combination: DESIGN's 'hound forces the jump that the wasp contests', measured rather than asserted. A perfectly timed dodge (1300-1330ms, what hound-jump.json uses) still clears both, so the squeeze is a window that mastery can thread, not a wall.
